Zstandard WASM bundle
====================

Source: @oneidentity/zstd-js 1.0.3, wasm/index.umd.js
Underlying Zstandard source: facebook/zstd v1.4.8

Local compatibility fix:
- The published ZstdSimple compressor allocated input length + 18 bytes, copied only the input, then compressed the entire allocation. The extra bytes could contain stale WASM heap contents. The vendored bundle now compresses exactly the input length.
- The published ZstdSimple decompressor subtracted 18 bytes from the returned length to hide that padding. The vendored bundle now returns the full decompressed frame length.

The converter pads inputs shorter than 101 bytes with known zero bytes before compression. Its decoder verifies and removes that padding.
